map.石头克剪刀、剪刀克布、布克石头；平局重来。AI 纯随机时玩家长期约 1/3 胜、: Rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, paper beats rock; a draw replays the round. Against a purely random AI the player ends up around 1/3 wins, 1/3 draws and 1/3 losses in the long run (level). Includes a scoreboard and win streak tracking. …
map.休闲对战：人机出拳，记分板与连胜记录。: Casual versus AI: the AI throws a move and a scoreboard tracks the win streak.
map.决策小游戏：纠结时交给随机。: A decision mini-game: when you are torn, let randomness decide.
map.算法演示：观察 AI 策略（随机/读规律）。: Algorithm demo: watch the AI strategy (random / pattern-reading).
map.能稳定赢 AI 吗？: Can I beat the AI consistently?
map.对纯随机 AI 长期均势；对读规律 AI 可用随机化破其预测，但无必胜法。: Against a purely random AI you are level in the long run; against an AI that reads patterns you can use randomisation to break its predictions, but there is no guaranteed win.
map.同手出相同则平，记入平局数不计入连胜。: The same move from both sides is a draw; it counts as a draw and does not extend the win streak.
